method.timing_includes: MEX dispatch, input parsing, allocation, upload, kernels and download; TPE also includes ordered candidate sampling. RNG handle creation/destruction excluded.
method.density_reference: Vectorized MATLAB analytical continuous-mixture density, one CPU thread. This is not an Optuna Python or CPU C++ speed comparison.
method.cold_start: Engine startup recorded privately; GPU initialization and first MEX density call recorded per run. No absolute cold-start acceptance claim.
method.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap intervals, 2000 resamples, fixed seed 20261012; per-session raw observations retained.
method.host_selection: Original timing host has no NVIDIA GPU and was busy. User selected this idle A100 host instead; results are not relabeled as the original host.

limitations: Small density calls remain slower than the MATLAB host reference. No CPU fallback was introduced.
GPU/workload-specific results; do not generalize to other GPUs or all Optuna workloads.
Bootstrap intervals describe observed call variability; two sessions per variant do not establish between-machine reliability.
